nodes.criteria: Assess the image as a whole. Complete: it convincingly reads as a chalk drawing, with the scene rendered as drawn forms and chalk-like marks throughout, rather than a photograph merely blurred or overlaid with chalk-like texture. Partial: clear visible movement toward a chalk drawing (such as chalk-like texture or sketchy forms), but the image still substantially reads as a photograph or the drawing transformation is incomplete. Absent: no visible progress toward a chalk drawing. Unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine progress or completion. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.

Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.
